WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as required_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_with_order AS (
    SELECT 
        i.product_id,
        i.location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        i.purchase_id,
        p.purchased,
        i.qty,
        o.required_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN order_qty o ON i.product_id = o.product_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        location_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        qty,
        required_qty,
        rn,
        SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, qty, rn) as running_qty
    FROM inventory_with_order
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        location_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        qty,
        required_qty,
        rn,
        running_qty,
        LAG(running_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as prev_running
    FROM cumulative
),
picked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        location_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_running IS NULL THEN LEAST(qty, required_qty)
            ELSE CASE 
                WHEN prev_running < required_qty THEN LEAST(qty, required_qty - prev_running)
                ELSE 0
            END
        END as pick_qty
    FROM with_prev
)
SELECT product_id, location_id, aisle, position, pick_qty
FROM picked
WHERE pick_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, rn
